            <img src="/skins/bj2008/images/fire.gif" border="0" align="absmiddle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Robert.Yu/p/19636143" title="发布于 2026-02-25 10:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">智谱GLM-5 1 day适配华为昇腾（国产），744B模型单机高效推理，全量保姆配置过程</span>
    

</a>

        </div>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>智谱GLM-5 1 day适配华为昇腾（国产），744B模型单机高效推理，全量保姆配置过程</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在&nbsp;<strong>华为昇腾 Atlas 800T A3 </strong><strong>服务器</strong>&nbsp;上完成&nbsp;<strong>智谱 GLM-5</strong><strong>（744B</strong><strong>）模型单机全量推理部署</strong>&nbsp;的&nbsp;<strong>完整、端到端、可复现的配置流程</strong>。本指南覆盖&nbsp;<strong>从裸机驱动安装 </strong><strong>→ </strong><strong>模型下载 </strong><strong>→ </strong><strong>容器化部署 </strong><strong>→ API </strong><strong>服务启动 </strong><strong>→ </strong><strong>性能验证</strong>&nbsp;全过程，适用于&nbsp;<strong>2026</strong><strong>年2</strong><strong>月最新环境</strong>，严格依据官方文档与社区实践整理。</p>
<div align="left"><hr align="left" noshade="noshade" size="0" width="100%"></div>
<p><strong>通过网盘分享的文件：麒麟</strong><strong>kylin linux </strong><strong>安装</strong><strong>CDH v7.1</strong><strong>指南</strong></p>
<p><strong>链接</strong><strong>:https://pan.baidu.com/s/1wbRWJUSyElplFgse_NyOwg?pwd=pgxn </strong><strong>提取码</strong><strong>:pgxn</strong></p>
<p><strong>通过网盘分享的文件：</strong><strong>Hadoop</strong></p>
<p><strong>链接</strong><strong>: https://pan.baidu.com/s/1PDj6dySUNHotNABp7d1a0w?pwd=57is </strong><strong>提取码</strong><strong>: 57is</strong></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>🧱 </strong><strong>一、硬件与系统准备</strong></p>
<p><strong>✅ </strong><strong>硬件要求</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>服务器型号：Atlas 800T A3（8×Ascend 910B NPU）</li>
<li>CPU：≥ 64 核（如 Kunpeng 920）</li>
<li>内存：≥ 512 GB DDR4</li>
<li>存储：≥ 2 TB NVMe SSD（建议 RAID 0）</li>
<li>网络：双万兆网卡（用于多节点通信，单机可忽略）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>✅ </strong><strong>操作系统</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>推荐 OS：openEuler 22.03 LTS ARM64<br>
     （ISO 下载：<a href="https://www.openeuler.org/zh/download/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.openeuler.org/zh/download/</a>）</li>


</ul>
<p>⚠️&nbsp;<strong>禁止使用 CentOS / Ubuntu</strong>！昇腾驱动仅官方支持 Euler 系列。</p>
<div align="left"><hr align="left" noshade="noshade" size="0" width="100%">

</div>
<p><strong>🔧 </strong><strong>二、安装 NPU </strong><strong>驱动与 CANN </strong><strong>工具链（首次部署必做）</strong></p>
<p>若已安装 CANN ≥ 8.0.RC1，请跳至第三步。</p>
<p><strong>1. </strong><strong>创建运行用户</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>groupadd HwHiAiUser</p>
<p>useradd -g HwHiAiUser -d /home/HwHiAiUser
-m HwHiAiUser -s /bin/bash</p>
<p><strong>2. </strong><strong>下载驱动与固件（以 CANN 8.0.RC2 </strong><strong>为例）</strong></p>
<p>从&nbsp;<a href="https://www.hiascend.com/software/cann" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">昇腾社区</a>&nbsp;获取：</p>
<ul>
<li>Ascend-hdk-atlas800t-a3-npu-driver_8.0.RC2_linux-aarch64.run</li>
<li>Ascend-hdk-atlas800t-a3-npu-firmware_8.0.RC2.run</li>
<li>Ascend-cann-toolkit_8.0.RC2_linux-aarch64.run</li>


</ul>
<p><strong>3. </strong><strong>安装驱动（按顺序！）</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p># 赋权</p>
<p>chmod +x *.run</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 安装驱动（指定用户）</p>
<p>./Ascend-hdk-atlas800t-a3-npu-driver_8.0.RC2_linux-aarch64.run
\</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--full --install-for-all \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--install-username=HwHiAiUser --install-usergroup=HwHiAiUser</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 安装固件</p>
<p>./Ascend-hdk-atlas800t-a3-npu-firmware_8.0.RC2.run
--full</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 安装 CANN Toolkit（开发依赖）</p>
<p>./Ascend-cann-toolkit_8.0.RC2_linux-aarch64.run
–full</p>
<p><strong>4. </strong><strong>验证安装</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>reboot&nbsp;
# 必须重启！</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>npu-smi info</p>
<p># 应输出 8 张 NPU 卡信息（Device ID 0~7）</p>
<p><strong>📦 </strong><strong>三、下载 GLM-5 W4A8 </strong><strong>量化模型</strong></p>
<p>原始 BF16 模型（1.5TB）无法单机部署，必须使用&nbsp;<strong>W4A8 </strong><strong>量化版</strong>（约 300GB）。</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>mkdir -p /root/.cache/glm-5-w4a8</p>
<p>cd /root/.cache/glm-5-w4a8</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 下载量化模型（AtomGit AI 提供）</p>
<p>wget
https://ai.atomgit.com/atomgit-ascend/GLM-5-w4a8/model.tar.gz</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 解压</p>
<p>tar -xzf model.tar.gz</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 验证结构（应含 config.json, tokenizer, pytorch_model*.bin）</p>
<p>ls -lh</p>
<p>🔗 官方地址：<a href="https://ai.atomgit.com/atomgit-ascend/GLM-5-w4a8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ai.atomgit.com/atomgit-ascend/GLM-5-w4a8</a></p>
<div align="left"><hr align="left" noshade="noshade" size="0" width="100%">

</div>
<p><strong>🐳 </strong><strong>四、拉取 vLLM-Ascend </strong><strong>推理镜像</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p># 使用 DaoCloud 加速镜像</p>
<p>export
IMAGE=m.daocloud.io/quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:glm5-a3-openeuler</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>docker pull $IMAGE</p>
<p>✅ 镜像特性：</p>
<ul>
<li>基于
     openEuler 22.03</li>
<li>预装 CANN
     8.0.RC2 + torch-npu 2.1.0 + vLLM-Ascend</li>
<li>内置
     Lightning Indexer / Sparse Flash Attention 融合算子</li>


</ul>
<p>▶️ 五、启动推理服务（关键脚本）</p>
<p>创建 start_glm5.sh：</p>
<p>Bash</p>
<p>#!/bin/bash</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>IMAGE="m.daocloud.io/quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:glm5-a3-openeuler"</p>
<p>MODEL_PATH="/root/.cache/glm-5-w4a8"</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>docker run --rm \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--name glm5-inference \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--net=host \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--shm-size=16g \</p>
<p>&nbsp; --device
/dev/davinci0 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci1 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci2 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci3 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci4 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci5 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci6 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci7 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/davinci_manager \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/devmm_svm \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
--device /dev/hisi_hdc \</p>
<p>&nbsp; -v
/usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \</p>
<p>&nbsp; -v
/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \</p>
<p>&nbsp; -v
/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \</p>
<p>&nbsp; -v
/etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \</p>
<p>&nbsp; -v
/root/.cache:/root/.cache \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
$IMAGE \</p>
<p>&nbsp;
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
--model $MODEL_PATH \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
--trust-remote-code \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
--dtype bfloat16 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
--tensor-parallel-size 8 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; --max-model-len
200000 \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
--port 8000 \</p>
<p>--disable-log-stats</p>
<p>赋予执行权限并运行：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>chmod +x
start_glm5.sh</p>
<p>nohup
./start_glm5.sh &gt; glm5.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;</p>
<p align="left">🟢 成功标志：glm5.log&nbsp;中出现<br>
Uvicorn running on <a href="http://0.0.0.0:8000/" rel="noopener nofollow">http://0.0.0.0:8000</a></p>
<p align="left"><strong>🧪 </strong><strong>六、API </strong><strong>调用与性能验证</strong></p>
<p align="left"><strong>1. </strong><strong>基础调用测试</strong></p>
<p align="left">bash</p>
<p align="left">curl http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp; -H "Content-Type:
application/json" \</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp; -d '{</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; "model":
"glm-5",</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; "messages":
[{"role": "user", "content": "你好！"}],</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; "max_tokens": 50</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp; }'</p>
<p align="left"><strong>2. </strong><strong>长上下文测试（200K</strong><strong>）</strong></p>
<p align="left">python</p>
<p align="left"># generate_long.py</p>
<p align="left">import requests</p>
<p align="left">text = "A" * 190000&nbsp;
# 模拟长输入</p>
<p align="left">resp =
requests.post("http://localhost:8000/v1/completions", json={</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; "prompt": text,</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; "max_tokens":
1000</p>
<p align="left">})</p>
<p align="left">print("Status:", resp.status_code)</p>
<p align="left"><strong>3. </strong><strong>性能监控</strong></p>
<p align="left">bash</p>
<p align="left"># 实时查看 NPU 利用率</p>
<p align="left">npu-smi dperf -t 1</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;</p>
<p align="left"># 查看日志吞吐</p>
<p align="left">tail -f glm5.log | grep "tokens/s"</p>
<p align="left">💡 预期性能（Atlas 800T A3）：</p>
<ul>
<li>首 Token 延迟：&lt; 1.5 秒</li>
<li>解码速度：&gt; 45 tokens/s</li>
<li>显存占用：&lt; 320 GB</li>


</ul>
<p align="left"><strong>🔍 </strong><strong>七、故障排查清单</strong></p>
<p align="left">表格</p>
<table style="width: 786px" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<thead>
<tr>
<td nowrap="nowrap">
<p align="left"><strong>现象</strong></p>


   </td>
<td nowrap="nowrap">
<p align="left"><strong>原因</strong></p>


   </td>
<td nowrap="nowrap">
<p align="left"><strong>解决方案</strong></p>


   </td>


  </tr>


 </thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<p align="left">npu-smi: command not found</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">驱动未装或 PATH 错误</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">检查&nbsp;/usr/local/bin/npu-smi&nbsp;是否存在</p>


  </td>


 </tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p align="left">容器启动失败</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">设备未挂载全</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">确保挂载 davinci0~7 +
  manager + svm + hdc</p>


  </td>


 </tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p align="left">模型加载卡住</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">权限不足</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">chown -R root:root /root/.cache/glm-5-w4a8</p>


  </td>


 </tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p align="left">OOM（显存溢出）</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">用了 BF16 模型</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">确认使用&nbsp;<strong>W4A8 </strong><strong>量化版</strong></p>


  </td>


 </tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p align="left">Token 生成极慢</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">未启用 MTP/DSA</p>


  </td>
<td>
<p align="left">检查模型是否含&nbsp;mtp_config.json</p>


  </td>


 </tr>


</tbody>

</table>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="0" width="100%">

</div>
<p align="left"><strong>📚 </strong><strong>官方资源汇总</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>模型仓库：<a href="https://atomgit.com/zai-org/GLM-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://atomgit.com/zai-org/GLM-5</a></li>
<li>部署示例：<a href="https://atomgit.com/zai-org/GLM-5-code/blob/main/example/ascend.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://atomgit.com/zai-org/GLM-5-code/blob/main/example/ascend.md</a></li>
<li>量化工具：<a href="https://atomgit.com/Ascend/msmodelslim" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://atomgit.com/Ascend/msmodelslim</a></li>
<li>昇腾文档：<a href="https://www.hiascend.com/document" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.hiascend.com/document</a></li>


</ul>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="0" width="100%">

</div>
<p align="left"><strong>✅ </strong><strong>总结</strong></p>
<p align="left">通过以上&nbsp;<strong>六步全流程</strong>，您已在&nbsp;<strong>单台 Atlas 800T A3</strong>&nbsp;上成功部署&nbsp;<strong>744B </strong><strong>参数的 GLM-5</strong>，实现：</p>
<ul>
<li>200K 超长上下文</li>
<li>OpenAI 兼容 API</li>
<li>生产级推理吞吐</li>


</ul>
<p align="left">这标志着&nbsp;<strong>“国产大模型 + </strong><strong>国产算力”</strong>&nbsp;的全栈自主可控方案已具备&nbsp;<strong>企业级落地能力</strong>，为信创、金融、政务等高安全场景提供坚实底座。</p>
<p align="left">&nbsp;</p>
